title: Transcriptome Analysis Reveals POD as an Important Indicator for Assessing Low-Temperature Tolerance in Maize Radicles during Germination
genotypes: Demeiya1 (DMY1; flint); Zhengdan958 (ZD958; dent); both northeast China cultivars; paper does not label either tolerant or sensitive
tissue: radicle of germinated seeds (80 radicles pooled per replicate)
stage_age: seeds germinated 72 h at 15 °C (radicle 1.0-1.2 cm), then 48 h treatment
growth_system: climate chamber; dark; cardboard germination box with 10 mL sterile water (paper-bed); 50% RH
control_temperature: 15 ± 0.5 °C for 48 h in the dark (same box conditions)
timepoints_duration: single time point: 48 h at 5 °C vs 48 h at 15 °C (after 72 h pre-germination at 15 °C)
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq 4000 (Biomarker Technologies, Beijing); read layout NR
other_omics: LC-MS/MS metabolites of phenylpropanoid pathway; physiology (radicle growth, FW/DW, POD, MDA, proline); qPCR validation of 6 DEGs
key_finding: Cold at germination changed 5301 (DMY1) and 4894 (ZD958) radicle genes; phenylpropanoid pathway and peroxidase genes implicated.
notes: Reads mapped to B73 RefGen_v4 (HISAT2); DESeq2 |log2FC|>=1, FDR<0.01. Control (15 °C) is itself sub-optimal for maize. Accession given in text as 'login number' PRJNA1050059.

title: Transcriptome Analysis and QTL Mapping Identify Candidate Genes and Regulatory Mechanisms Related to Low-Temperature Germination Ability in Maize
genotypes: Ye478 (tolerant of low-temperature germination); Q1 (sensitive; bred from S7913 x a tropical landrace); DH population (123 lines, Ye478 x Q1) used for QTL only, not sequenced
tissue: embryos dissected from germinating seeds (10 embryos pooled per replicate)
stage_age: seeds soaked 20 h at 25 °C in 0.5% H2O2 (0 d), then sampled 1, 3 and 5 d after sowing
growth_system: growth chamber; seeds sown in vermiculite (20% water) in transparent germination boxes; 3000 lx light; photoperiod NR
cold_treatments: 12 °C (constant) from sowing; sampled at 1 d, 3 d, 5 d
control_temperature: 0 d baseline = seeds after 20 h soak at 25 °C (time-0, before cold); no 25 °C germination series was sequenced (25 °C used only for germination-rate phenotyping)
other_factors: genotype (tolerant vs sensitive); also catalase and SOD activity measured
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq 4000 PE150 (Huazhong Agricultural University); about 28.6 M read pairs per library
other_omics: CAT and SOD enzyme activity; QTL mapping (GBS bin map, DH population); WGCNA
key_finding: Tolerant Ye478 up-regulated ribosome synthesis under 12 °C germination; WGCNA modules plus chr1 QTL gave candidate genes.
source_of_details: PMC full text; accession search by web search failed
notes: No data availability statement or accession in the retrieved PMC text; MDPI publisher page refused (403), not retried. Cold effect is confounded with germination stage (baseline is the soaked 0 d seed). Mapped to B73 AGPv4 (HISAT2); DESeq, padj<0.05, FC>2.

title: Hub Gene Mining and Co-Expression Network Construction of Low-Temperature Response in Maize of Seedling by WGCNA
genotypes: B144 (cold tolerant); Q319 (cold sensitive); both from Maize Research Institute, Heilongjiang Academy of Agricultural Sciences
growth_system: light incubator (Conviron GEN1000); 12/12 h light/dark; nutrient soil:vermiculite 3:1
n_libraries: 18 (2 genotypes x 3 time points x 3 reps)
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq 4000; read layout NR (113.56 M raw reads stated for 18 samples)
key_finding: Tolerant B144 kept 4929 DEGs at 24 h versus 430 in sensitive Q319; WGCNA modules and hub genes identified.
source_of_details: PMC full text; accession from web-search snippet quoting the paper (link was stripped in PMC text)
notes: Accession PRJNA666026 not verified on NCBI. A later paper from the same group (PMC11595045, multi-omics of B144/Q319 low temperature, 24 h leaves, HiSeq 4000) may reuse or extend these data; overlap not checked. Clean-read mapping rate >85%; DESeq2 logFC>=2, padj<0.01.

title: QTL-seq and transcriptomic integrative analyses reveal two positively regulated genes that control the low-temperature germination ability of MTP-maize introgression lines
genotypes: IB030 (strong low-temperature germination; MTP introgression line from maize x Tripsacum dactyloides x Zea perennis); B73 (recurrent parent). F2 of IB030 x Mo17 (weak) used for QTL-seq
other_factors: genotype (introgression line vs B73); Z. perennis/Tripsacum introgression (flag: non-Zea Tripsacum in pedigree)
timepoints_duration: NR beyond 27 d at 10 °C and 7 d at 25 °C (as stated in abstract)
other_omics: QTL-seq (bulk segregant sequencing); QTL mapping; functional validation of ZmbZIP113 and ZmTSAH1
key_finding: RNA-seq plus QTL-seq identified ZmbZIP113 and ZmTSAH1 as positive regulators of low-temperature germination in IB030.
source_of_details: abstract + web search; Springer page not readable (redirected to login, not retried)
notes: Abstract only; no full text in PMC. Design details, replicates and accession unconfirmed. Cold and control durations differ (27 d vs 7 d) as stated in abstract; probably matched germination stage but not confirmed. Introgression-line germplasm includes Zea perennis and Tripsacum.
